title: Vercel Function returns 504 FUNCTION_INVOCATION_TIMEOUT after 10 or 15 seconds on an older project
symptoms: Timeouts at 10 seconds on Hobby or 15 seconds on Pro while the docs promise 300 seconds
Long AI or scraping calls die mid-stream
cause: The 300 second default applies only when Fluid compute is on, and Fluid compute is enabled by default only for projects created on or after April 23, 2025. Older projects keep the legacy short defaults until Fluid is switched on or maxDuration is set.
fix: Turn on Fluid compute for the project and redeploy, or set maxDuration on the function within your plan maximum.
affected: Projects created before 2025-04-23 without Fluid compute; Hobby legacy default 10 s (max 60 s), Pro legacy default 15 s
